title: Object list + sentinel + min
prompt: Implement `double bestPrice(ArrayList<Sale> sales, String item)`: smallest cents among that item's sales as a double, −1.0 when absent. Three machines: object for-each with a filter, a seeded min, and a sentinel for absence.

tests.name: best price found
tests.hint: Seed best = -1; when found, seed from the first match, keep strict <.
